Scene: river landing on a small sandy island in the flooded Danube, early evening in July. An upturned long wooden Canadian canoe rests on the sand at the left, a narrow backwater in front, fast wide river beyond, low willow thickets framing the banks. Far horizon obscured by endless silver-green willows beneath wind-driven clouds. View from the island toward the river. Keep the overturned canoe clear and its hull intact with a fine dark seam.
